intro: A sample of recent work around Wilkes-Barre and the surrounding boroughs — weekly mowing, bed and mulch work, overgrowth clearing, weed control and winter snow clearing.

projects.title: Weekly lawn mowing
projects.alt: A Smile Lawn Care crew member mowing a large striped back lawn with a commercial walk-behind mower
projects.description: Weekly mow on a residential back lawn with a commercial walk-behind, cut at a consistent height so the stripe stays even and the turf recovers between visits.

projects.title: Mulch installation & bed maintenance
projects.alt: The front of a home with freshly mulched foundation beds, trimmed shrubs, hostas and a cleanly edged lawn
projects.description: Beds re-cut and edged, shrubs trimmed back into shape, and fresh dark mulch laid around the foundation planting and the front walk.

projects.title: Fresh mulch, delivered and spread
projects.alt: A smiley face drawn in yellow mulch on top of a pile of fresh dark mulch
projects.description: A load of mulch on site ready to go out. Customers keep telling us the mulch quality is the part they notice most, so we do not cut corners on it.

projects.title: Overgrowth & property clean-up
projects.alt: A Smile Lawn Care crew member in a company shirt cutting back heavy overgrowth along a property line
projects.description: Heavy growth along a property line cut back and hauled off, re-establishing the boundary and the usable edge of the yard.

projects.title: Weed control & bed clearing
projects.alt: Gloved hands in a Smile Lawn Care shirt holding a handful of weeds pulled from a stone bed
projects.description: Weeds pulled out of a stone bed by hand rather than just sprayed and left standing — the difference shows a week later.

projects.title: Snow blowing & ice control
projects.alt: A residential driveway being cleared with a two-stage snow blower after a heavy snowfall
projects.description: Driveway and walks cleared down to the surface after an overnight storm, then treated so they do not glaze over again.
